nameEn: Manufacture of electronic components and boards
description: This class includes the manufacture of electronic components and printed circuit boards.
includes: manufacture of printed circuit boards (without assembled components)
manufacture of semiconductors and related devices: transistors, diodes, solar cells
manufacture of integrated circuits (analog, digital, mixed)
manufacture of inductors, coils, transformers and other magnetic components
manufacture of connectors for electronic applications
manufacture of switches, relays for electronic applications
manufacture of crystals and crystal assemblies
manufacture of solenoids, switches and transducers for electronic applications
manufacture of display components: LCD, LED, plasma panels
excludes: manufacture of computers and computer peripherals, see 2620
manufacture of loaded printed circuit boards, see 2620, 2630, 2640, 2650, 2660, 2670, 2680
manufacture of transformers for power distribution, see 2710
